themes_detail.label: Water Quality Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Water quality complaints spiked to 4 THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks—a 3,100% increase (z-score: 11.72)—suggesting a potential contamination event or system failure in Far Rockaway requiring immediate investigation and resident notification.
evidence: 4 water quality complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly baseline (3,100% spike)
z-score of 11.72 indicates extreme statistical anomaly
Long-standing CB budget request for DEP capital projects suggests known water infrastructure gaps in district
reporting_angles: Contact DEP immediately: what triggered the spike? Are there boil water advisories or known contamination?
Interview residents: what water quality issues are they experiencing (discoloration, odor, taste)?
Investigate infrastructure: does this connect to the repeated CB requests for sewer and water system upgrades?

themes_detail.label: Damaged Street Signage Surge
themes_detail.summary: Street sign damage complaints exploded to 19 THIS WEEK vs. 2.8 weekly average—a 591% spike (z-score: 9.91)—indicating possible weather damage, vehicle impact, or organized sign theft affecting public safety and navigation in the Rockaways.
evidence: 19 street sign complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.8 weekly average (591% increase)
z-score of 9.91 indicates extreme statistical anomaly
High volume suggests systemic issue rather than isolated incidents
reporting_angles: Canvass the district: are signs missing, bent, or vandalized? Map the affected areas.
Contact DOT: are they aware of the spike? What's the repair timeline?
Investigate cause: was there severe weather, vehicle collisions, or coordinated damage?

themes_detail.label: Dead/Dying Trees in Rockaways
themes_detail.summary: Dead or dying tree complaints spiked to 5 THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average—a 1,233% increase (z-score: 9.55)—potentially reflecting storm damage, disease, or long-deferred maintenance in a district already requesting park reconstruction funding.
evidence: 5 dead/dying tree complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.4 weekly average (1,233% spike)
z-score of 9.55 indicates extreme statistical anomaly
Recurring CB budget requests for park upgrades suggest infrastructure strain in district
reporting_angles: Visit affected areas: document the condition of trees. Are they storm-damaged or diseased?
Contact Parks Dept: what's their removal/replacement timeline?
Connect to broader narrative: does this reflect deferred maintenance across district parks and streetscapes?

themes_detail.label: Abandoned Vehicles Spike
themes_detail.summary: Abandoned vehicle complaints jumped to 44 LAST WEEK vs. 18.8 weekly average—a 135% increase (z-score: 3.55)—indicating a possible enforcement gap or uptick in vehicle dumping in the Rockaways.
evidence: 44 abandoned vehicle complaints LAST WEEK vs. 18.8 weekly average (135% increase)
z-score of 3.55 indicates strong statistical anomaly
Abandoned vehicles are #10 on 90-day complaint list (272 total), suggesting chronic issue now accelerating
reporting_angles: Map hot spots: where in Far Rockaway are abandoned vehicles clustering?
Contact NYPD and Sanitation: why the surge? Are enforcement resources stretched?
Interview residents: how long do vehicles sit? What's the impact on neighborhood quality?

themes_detail.label: Street/Sidewalk Noise Spike
themes_detail.summary: Street and sidewalk noise complaints surged to 36 LAST WEEK vs. 10.5 weekly average—a 243% increase (z-score: 5.63)—potentially linked to construction activity, with 426 DOB permits filed in the past 90 days and multiple active waterfront development projects underway.
evidence: 36 street/sidewalk noise complaints LAST WEEK vs. 10.5 weekly average (243% increase)
z-score of 5.63 indicates strong statistical anomaly
426 active DOB building permits filed in past 90 days; Edgemere Commons Phase 2B, Arverne East Phase 3, and multiple rezonings active
General construction complaints also UP 129% LAST WEEK (18 vs. 7.9 average)
reporting_angles: Map active construction sites: which projects are generating complaints?
Interview residents: what are noise sources and hours? Are permits being violated?
Contact DOB and CB: are there compliance audits underway for active projects?
